# Week 3: Practice vector operations

## Load packages and download data

```{r}
# Load packages
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(tmap)
```

```{r}
sb_protected_areas <- st_read(here("data", "week3", "cpad_super_units_sb.shp")) |>  
  st_transform("ESRI:102009") # matching cooridnate systems for all loaded data

sb_city_boundaries <- st_read(here("data", "week3", "sb_city_boundaries_2003.shp")) |> 
  st_transform("ESRI:102009") # matching cooridnate systems for all loaded data

sb_county_boundary <- st_read(here("data", "week3", "sb_county_boundary_2020.shp")) |> 
  st_transform("ESRI:102009") # matching cooridnate systems for all loaded data

aves <- st_read(here("data", "week3", "aves_observations_2020_2024.shp")) |> 
  st_transform("ESRI:102009") # matching cooridnate systems for all loaded data
```

## Find bird observations within PAs in Santa Barbara County

Find how many bird observations are within protected areas in Santa Barbara County and show how your output differs with a spatial subset versus a spatial join

```{r}
# Spatial subset: how many polygons have birds
bird_obs_protected_subset <- sb_protected_areas[aves, ] # only returns rows where polygons had a bird observation

nrow(bird_obs_protected_subset) # returns 35 rows

tm_shape(sb_county_boundary) +
  tm_fill() +
  tm_shape(sb_protected_areas) +
    tm_borders(lwd = 1, col = "#fb8500") +
    tm_fill(col = "#fb8500", alpha = 0.2) +
  tm_shape(bird_obs_protected_subset) +
    tm_dots(col = "#023047")
```

```{r}
# Spatial join: returns all bird observations and adds protected area information to those that are in protected areas
bird_obs_protected_join <- st_join(aves, sb_protected_areas) # defaults to st_intersects and a left join by default

nrow(bird_obs_protected_join) # returns 500 rows

tm_shape(sb_county_boundary) +
  tm_fill() +
  tm_shape(sb_protected_areas) +
    tm_borders(lwd = 1, col = "#fb8500") +
    tm_fill(col = "#fb8500", alpha = 0.2) +
  tm_shape(bird_obs_protected_join) +
    tm_dots(col = "#023047")
```

```{r}
# Example using inner join: shows only bird observations within protected areas
bird_obs_protected_inner <- st_join(aves, sb_protected_areas, left = FALSE)

nrow(bird_obs_protected_inner)

tm_shape(sb_county_boundary) +
  tm_fill() +
  tm_shape(sb_protected_areas) +
    tm_borders(lwd = 1, col = "#fb8500") +
    tm_fill(col = "#fb8500", alpha = 0.2) +
  tm_shape(bird_obs_protected_inner) +
    tm_dots(col = "#023047")
```


Make a 5 km buffer around the protected areas and subset buffered geometries to only those with bird observations

```{r}
sb_protected_5km_buffer <- st_buffer(sb_protected_areas, dist = 5000) # 5000 meters

bird_obs_buffer <- sb_protected_5km_buffer[aves, ]

nrow(bird_obs_buffer)

tm_shape(sb_county_boundary) +
  tm_fill() +
  tm_shape(sb_protected_areas) +
    tm_borders(lwd = 1, col = "#fb8500") +
    tm_fill(col = "#fb8500", alpha = 0.2) +
  tm_shape(bird_obs_buffer) +
  tm_dots(col = "#023047")
```

## Find PAs within 15km of Goleta

Find the protected areas within 15 km of a city in Santa Barbara County
Hint: Use dplyr::filter() to select a city from sb_city_boundaries

```{r}
# Subset SB county to Goleta
goleta <- sb_city_boundaries |> 
  dplyr::filter(NAME == "Goleta")

st_crs(goleta)$units  # Check if units are in meters

goleta_buffer_15km <- st_buffer(goleta, dist = 15000) # Create 15 km buffer around Goleta
```

Explore different outputs for #3 with st_intersects(), st_intersection(), and st_within()

```{r}
goleta_PAs_within <- st_within(sb_protected_areas, goleta_buffer_15km) # only returns true if sb protected area is entirely within the buffer

sum(lengths(goleta_PAs_within) > 0)
```

```{r}
goleta_PAs_intersect <- st_intersects(sb_protected_areas, goleta_buffer_15km) # returns sb protected areas that touch or overlap the buffer at all

sum(lengths(goleta_PAs_intersect) > 0)
```

```{r}
goleta_PAs_intersection <- st_intersection(sb_protected_areas, goleta_buffer_15km) # same as above but clips out protected areas

nrow(goleta_PAs_intersection)
```

Practice a distance-based join with st_is_within_distance()

```{r}
goleta_PAs_join <- st_join(sb_protected_areas, goleta, st_is_within_distance, dist = 15000)
```

## Find distance between Goleta and Dangermond Preserve

Find the distance between your city of choice and a protected area of your choice, using the geometries’ edges and the centroid

```{r}
# Subset PA to Dangermond Preserve
dangermond <- sb_protected_areas |>
  dplyr::filter(UNIT_NAME == "Jack and Laura Dangermond Preserve")
```

```{r}
danger_dist <- st_distance(goleta, dangermond) # Compute the distance between geometries edges

danger_dist # units are in meters
```

```{r}
# Calculate the geometric center
dangermond_centroid <- st_centroid(dangermond)
goleta_centroid <- st_centroid(goleta)

danger_dist_centroid <- st_distance(goleta_centroid, dangermond_centroid) # Compute the distance between geometries center

danger_dist_centroid # units are in meters
```

```{r}
# Check if the distance matrices are equal
danger_dist == danger_dist_centroid
```
